user.description: Pick your scale. If it isn't listed, step on it and try again: it only advertises right after a weigh-in.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? The scale must be in Bluetooth mode (see the documentation).

key.description: The scale only shares measurements with clients that know its secret key (kl), which is stored in your Withings account.

menu_options.login: Fetch the key with my Withings login

login.description:
Your credentials are sent only to Withings, once, to download the key. They are not stored. Accounts that use Google or Apple sign-in need a Withings password first.

To choose another option, leave both fields empty and submit.

manual.description:
Paste the scale's kl key, for example from the project's fetch_kl tool.

To use your Withings login instead, leave the field empty and submit.

pair.title: Pair with the scale

passkey.title: Enter the code
passkey.description: Type the 6-digit code shown on the scale's display. You have about 30 seconds.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description:
Pairing didn't complete: {error}.

Hold the scale's button for 3 seconds and try again.

pair_unsupported.title: Pairing not possible here
pair_unsupported.description:
Home Assistant reaches the scale through an adapter that can't pair with a code: an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, or a system other than Linux (macOS pairs by itself when the scale asks).

You can continue without pairing. If syncs fail later, make sure a Bluetooth adapter connected to this Home Assistant is close to the scale, then use Reconfigure to pair.

pair_timeout.title: The scale didn't show up
pair_timeout.description:
No setup-mode signal from the scale within 90 seconds.

Hold the button under the scale for 3 seconds, then try again. Make sure your phone's Bluetooth is off so the Withings app doesn't grab the scale.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The scale refused the connection because it isn't paired with this Home Assistant (for example after a battery change, or if the pairing was removed). Submit to pair again.

error.invalid_auth: Withings rejected the email or password.
error.no_scale: No matching scale was found on this Withings account, or multiple scales could not be distinguished.
error.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a valid key.
error.missing_credentials: Enter both email and password, or leave both empty to go back.
error.invalid_passkey: Enter the 6 digits shown on the scale.

abort.no_devices_found: No scale found. Step on it so it advertises, then try again.
abort.not_supported: This device isn't a supported Withings scale.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Done. The scale is set up again.
abort.reauth_successful: Done. The scale is paired again.
abort.pairing_not_available: Body (WBS06) requires a local Linux Bluetooth Classic adapter with BlueZ pairing support. Add an adapter and try again.

progress.wait_for_scale: Hold the button under the scale for 3 seconds. When the scale shows a 6-digit code, the next step asks for it.
progress.wait_for_scale_wbs06: Hold the button under the scale for 3 seconds. Home Assistant will pair the Classic Bluetooth connection required for weigh-ins, without a passkey.
